# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v3 c11 P15](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley / Seven Gulls, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v2 c6 P28](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0028), [v4 c6 P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Rufus was a handsome, tall, and fairly slim man with hazel and blue eyes, a high-colored complexion, and fair hair. He had a strong resemblance to his double cousin Laurence Vane, sharing his facial features and mismatched eyes.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 c11 P23](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0023), [v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013)_

## Personality

Rufus possessed a small, wicked soul and a self-centered, changeable disposition. He was persistent in pursuing his desires, but quickly lost interest once he obtained them. Though generally pleasant when things went his way, he had a selfish nature, a short temper, and a habit of heavy drinking.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 c11 P28](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0028), [v3 c11 P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)_

## Traits

- Small, wicked soul  <sub>[v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- Seafaring and store clerking  <sub>[v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Lorna Ainslie  <sub>[v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane grew up in Seven Gulls, working in his father's store during the winter and going to sea in the summer. He became enamored with Lorna Ainslie and pursued her persistently despite her repeated rejections. Taking advantage of his father's mortgage on the Ainslie farm, he coerced Lorna into marrying him by threatening to foreclose on her widowed mother. Following their marriage, he soon grew restless with domestic life. In the spring following their wedding, he departed on a voyage to Havana aboard the 'Four Sisters' with his cousin Laurence Vane. While in Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever and died, though back home in Seven Gulls his death went unconfirmed for thirteen years. Instead, his cousin Laurence, who suffered brain damage from a severe head injury in Havana, was mistaken for Rufus and brought back to Seven Gulls, where Lorna cared for him believing him to be her husband until an operation restored Laurence's memory.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 c11 P27](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0027), [v3 c11 P28](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 c11 P6](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0006), [v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013)_
